notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). Load-balancer configuration: nginx upstreams (round-robin, weighted/backup, ip_hash) with TLS termination, a full HAProxy config with health checks and stats, HAProxy runtime management, AWS ALB/NLB creation with the aws CLI, an ALB in Terraform, an algorithm table and troubleshooting.

Medium because it has the agent change live infrastructure: `sudo systemctl reload haproxy` and drain/maint/ready via the admin socket (SKILL.md:198-215), and `aws elbv2 create-load-balancer/create-target-group/register-targets/create-listener` using the user's AWS credentials (222-290). Acceptable: these create or reconfigure load balancers the user asked to set up, the HAProxy section validates config with `haproxy -c` before reload, the Terraform sets `enable_deletion_protection = true`, and nothing deletes resources or weakens TLS (TLS 1.2+/1.3 policies throughout).

All IDs, ARNs, subnets and hostnames are placeholders. The NLB example creates an internet-facing TCP:5432 (PostgreSQL) target group without a security group (SKILL.md:277-290); users should not expose a database that way without network restrictions. Related Skills links `../reverse-proxy/`, `../dns-management/`, `../cdn-setup/`, `../service-mesh/` (SKILL.md:384-387) are optional sibling skills that do not ship with this one.
